notes: School of Music official Music - Bachelor of Music - Jazz Four Year Academic Plan. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out (only the major is audited).

MUSC229J (large jazz ensemble), MUSC229Z (small jazz ensemble) and MUSC099 (recital attendance) are repeatable 1-credit courses, entered multiple times per the plan's own '(1 cr. x N semesters)' legend lines; see the program's reviewNotes.

The '1 semester of 400-level music history elective' generic slot is filled with MUSC450, and the '3-5 credits of music electives' slot with MUSC461, both real MUSC course numbers named elsewhere in the fetched plan text (this area's own plan names no specific course for either slot).
